description: Provenance and claim boundaries for the conservative RLL s-sector primordial expansion bound.

sources.guard: Historical FASE20 upper limit; later G6 convergence/RNG work means this is used only for a conservative scoped bound, not as a current model-preference receipt.

sources.citation: S. Borsanyi et al., Nature 539, 69-71 (2016), arXiv:1606.07494
sources.use: Supports g_rho/g_s thermodynamic degrees of freedom and entropy-based time/temperature cosmology; no numerical lattice table is ingested in this V1 bound.

sources.citation: A. Bazavov et al. (HotQCD), Phys. Rev. D 90, 094503 (2014)
sources.use: Establishes a lattice-QCD equation of state across the crossover region; numeric EoS ingestion remains a later tightening step.

sources.citation: Particle Data Group, Big-Bang Nucleosynthesis review (2024)
sources.guard: The derived ~1% expansion comparison is a BBN-era proxy, not a direct observational constraint at the QCD transition.
v2/v3 in O-O and Ne-Ne are not a cosmological likelihood and are not evidence for RLL.
